mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_invoice (order_id, merchant_id, invoice_no, invoice_type, title, tax_no, amount, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{merchantId}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceType}, #{title}, #{taxNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE order_invoice SET status = 2, cancel_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id as orderId, merchant_id as merchantId, invoice_no as invoiceNo, invoice_type as invoiceType, title, tax_no as taxNo, amount, status, create_time as createTime, cancel_time as cancelTime FROM order_invoice WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, order_id as orderId, merchant_id as merchantId, invoice_no as invoiceNo, invoice_type as invoiceType, title, tax_no as taxNo, amount, status, create_time as createTime, cancel_time as cancelTime FROM order_invoice WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, order_id as orderId, merchant_id as merchantId, invoice_no as invoiceNo, invoice_type as invoiceType, title, tax_no as taxNo, amount, status, create_time as createTime, cancel_time as cancelTime FROM order_invoice WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_id as orderId, merchant_id as merchantId, invoice_no as invoiceNo, invoice_type as invoiceType, title, tax_no as taxNo, amount, status, create_time as createTime, cancel_time as cancelTime FROM order_invoice WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
